text.description_html:
Brass Accents A04-K5060, 7-3/8" Gothic Style Neptune Door Knocker

This large very heavy (nearly 4 pounds of solid brass! ). Gothic style door knocker is modeled from the Victorian era. The top portion has an ornate pattern, while the bottom features the face of Neptune, God of the sea. Everything about this fancy door knocker drips with old world beauty.

This door knocker is thru-bolt mounted with 3-3/8" center to center mounting holes (distance between the 2 mounting bolt holes). Come packaged with matching finish screws for easy installation.

Specifications for the Brass Accents A04-K5060 Gothic Door Knocker:

  • Total Height: 7-3/8"
  • Knocker Width: 5-7/8"
  • Plate Width: 3-5/16"
  • Mounting Centers: 3-3/8" C/C (distance between the 2 mounting screw holes)
  • Mounting: Thru-Bolted (Screws go thru the door)
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Available in 12 Finishes

No matter which finish you choose for the outside, it will still be solid brass material inside.
